mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_task t WHERE t.order_id = o.id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM material_task t WHERE t.order_id = o.id AND t.status <> 'CONFIRMED' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_task t JOIN material_order o ON o.id = t.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.assignee_id IS NULL

SELECT o.id AS `id`, o.order_no AS `orderNo`, o.title AS `title`, o.created_at AS `createdAt`, c.name AS `customerName` FROM material_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'PENDING_CONFIRM' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id AS `id`, t.name AS `name`, o.id AS `orderId`, o.order_no AS `orderNo`, o.title AS `orderTitle`, t.updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM material_task t JOIN material_order o ON o.id = t.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id AS `id`, t.name AS `name`, t.status AS `status`, o.id AS `orderId`, o.order_no AS `orderNo`, t.updated_at AS `updatedAt` FROM material_task t JOIN material_order o ON o.id = t.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'REVISION', 'DESIGNING', 'PENDING_CONFIRM') ORDER BY FIELD(t.status, 'REVISION', 'PENDING', 'DESIGNING', 'PENDING_CONFIRM'), t.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
